title: The Official College of Architects of León (COAL)
description:
The Official College of Architects of León (COAL) was established on July 12, 1931, encompassin
g the regions of León, Asturias, and Galicia. The College of Galicia was legally separated in 1
973 and the College of Asturias in 1981.

We will upload 77gb of corporate data soon. Detailed personal information (passports), financia
ls, students and clients information and so on.
